missing_evidence: Payment service logs/metrics/traces for the same window to confirm the 503 origin
candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, which order propagates as 502 on /v1/orders and gateway surfaces as 502 on /v1/checkout. Traces show the failing hop is payment, not inventory (reservations return 200).
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side logs, metrics or traces are in scope; the 503 origin (crash, saturation, config) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s are fast (47-63ms) and correlate with payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations; order maps that to 502 and gateway to 502. Inventory/redis reservations succeed. Root cause is bounded to the payment hop, but payment-side telemetry is absent, so the specific failure mode is unconfirmed.
